data.name: Riana
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Riana is derived from the word ‘Rinnah’ which means ‘joyful song’ or ‘melodic voice’. In the Bible, Riana is mentioned as a name of one of the daughters of the tribe of Asher. It is also associated with the Hebrew word ‘Ranana’, which means ‘pleasing’, further emphasizing its connection to joy and happiness.
